keyPhrases.text: Ms. Mulligan is strong and centered
Mr. Nighy's performance is very interesting and all wrong
pointlessly over-elaborate set swamps the script
don't emit the scent of mutual desire
They act like father and daughter, not unhappy lovers
final grade up to a B-double-minus
unless you're a fan of hers, don't bother

reasoning: While praising the play itself and Mulligan's performance, the critic finds the revival 'disappointing' with major flaws in direction, male lead performance, set design, and chemistry. Explicit negative recommendation 'don't bother' and 'B-double-minus' grade indicate 2/5 territory.
